lines.zh: 我的三百条腿，一齐踩过苔藓。
lines.en: My three hundred legs step across the moss together.
Hundreds of legs touch down in turn.
I crawl along the cave wall.
My segments compress and stretch.
A thin trace stays in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕过一块钟乳石。
lines.en: I slowly round a stalactite.
My footfalls sound like fine rain.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时身体打了个弯。
lines.en: My body curls as I turn.

lines.zh: 潮湿的地面让我走得稳。
lines.en: Damp ground steadies my walk.
I climb the cave wall.
My tail is still trailing behind.
I pour segment by segment into the gap.
Cave water drips onto my back.
I skirt the glowing moss.
I shift slowly across the rubble.

lines.zh: 我的脚多，但一点也不乱。
lines.en: So many legs, yet none out of step.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴里，我的脚多得数不清。
lines.en: In the lush cave, I've more feet than you can count.
My segments open and close.
The cave is still but for dripping.
I tuck my head under my plates.
I sway my antennae slowly.
Beads of water on moss are cold.
I press against a warm stone.
I wait for the cave's damp air.
My legs paddle gently.
I can't count my own legs.
Water falls from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我盘成一圈，只留触角在外。
lines.en: I coil into a ring, leaving only my antennae out.
Your light is on me.
Watch your step, I'm by your boot.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴尖前，一节节爬过。
lines.en: I crawl past the tip of your boot, segment by segment.
You're drawn to caves too?
My shell is hard, not tasty.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞穴湿壁，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I inch along the damp cave wall.
I can't see you, only the light.

lines.zh: 你堵住石缝，我只能绕远。
lines.en: You block the rock crevice, so I must go around.
We're both heading down.

lines.zh: 洞穴里，你的呼吸回音很重。
lines.en: In the cave your breath echoes heavily.
I've curled into a ball.
One of my plates has cracked.
I've lost some legs.
Don't grind me.
Some fluid seeps out of me.
I withdraw into the crevice.
Pain makes me coil.
I squirm very slowly.
One segment of my shell cracked; I still crawl.
I press tight to the rock.
Is that rotting leaf?
Lower it, I can't reach.
You wouldn't have what I eat.
This smell is somewhat familiar.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度我感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel the warmth of your palm.
I'll crawl over and look.
Don't shake, crumbs will fall.
Not edible, but fragrant.
I approach, then stop.
Rare to find such things down here.
You pressed down on my tail segment.
One of my segments got pressed.
So many segments — I curl into a ball.
You touched hundreds of my legs.
Don't kick.
I crawl onto your boot.
My shell scraped you.

lines.zh: 撞了就缩，这是我的习惯。
lines.en: Hit me and I curl, that's my habit.
I'll clear the way, go on.
I curl up faster than you retreat.
A cave mate must know how to wait.
I've never thought about that.
My segments aren't ready yet.
Too few legs, unlike me.
Only damp places will do.
Quiet, don't disturb the cave.
I'd rather find a warm stone.
Such things happen in the dark.
Go on, I'm going to coil up.
We're not suited.
A fallen leaf, perfect.
I hug it with my front legs.
This bit of humus is edible.
I drag it back to the crevice.
Nothing is free down here.
This pebble was in the way.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着落叶，推到洞口。
lines.en: I push a fallen leaf to the burrow mouth with my head.

lines.zh: 腐叶间有颗小石子，我卷起来。
lines.en: A pebble lies among the rotten leaves; I curl around it.
I crawl over and cover it.
Stow it, gnaw slowly.
You're across the line I'm crawling.
I smell rotting leaves.
I only want to get past.
I curl, ready to roll.
The tunnel is narrow, don't thrash.
What you hold is crumbling.
I come slowly, no rush.
Don't kick stones.
Miss your step and you'll fall.
I'll go around you, that's all.

lines.zh: 我缩紧节壳，朝你脚边钻。
lines.en: I tighten my segmented shell and burrow toward your feet.
I know these crevices.
I crawl in segment by segment.
You can't hold so many segments.
My legs are quicker than your hands.
I come out the other side.
The cave's echo helps me.
You can only see my tail.
I've curled into a ball.
The cracks are wider than you.
I don't bite, I only hide.
Water flows down, so do I.
Do you hear the dripping?
All these legs, and I walk silent.

lines.zh: 我的头壳碰了你一下，别踩我。
lines.en: My head plate bumps you—don't step on me.
My shell scraped you.
I clench, then spring away.
My body isn't made for fighting.
I crawl over your instep.
This is only a push.
I shed a few bits of shell.
Don't come near the crevice.
I've curled back in.
Don't grab me.
I emerge from under the moss.
A thin rustle joins the cave.
My segments unfold one by one.

lines.zh: 水滴落在我刚到的背上。
lines.en: Water drips on my just-arrived back.
I come down the cave wall.
A bit of shell shows in the crack.
Something stirs beneath the litter.
I stretch out, very long.
The cave mouth's draft cools me.
I crawl into this damp dark.
Fire makes my shell brittle.
I fall from the ceiling and scatter.

lines.zh: 水淹了进来，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water floods in, I can't breathe.
The blast slams me into the wall.
An arrow lodges between my plates.
Magic makes me tingle all over.
No leaf litter, I can't move.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿石头传到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning travels the wet stone to me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可以贴的岩壁。
lines.en: No wall to cling to in the void.
